name: Ice Roller (1 N)
subtitle: For: Reducing Skin Puffiness  & Redness
usageInstructions: Open the product and add water till 80% capacity. For better results, you can add rose petals or cucumber. Keep in a freezer for a minimum of 4 hours, once frozen, rinse under water and then open the cover. Apply ice to the face in 30-second intervals and in circular motions

list.title: Important Information
list.content: To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this ice roller regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:  1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow   2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: Does this come with a water inlet?
list.content: Yes, it comes with an inlet for you to fill with water. You can put cucumber and rose petals inside and use the inlet to fill water.

list.title: Can I use it in the night?
list.content: It is a perfect tool to soothe your skin, you can use it during the day and night
